02 / A little background

Strategy meets
hands-on curiosity.

Nachiketh RameshResearch. Build. Learn.

I’m interested in what happens when business strategy meets the craft of making things.

My background spans technology, management consulting with BCG, and an MBA journey at Michigan Ross. I’ve worked across the ideation, design, development, and rollout of 50+ enterprise-grade products.

At Ross, events such as Tech-Innovation Jam and Dare to Dream helped me explore consumer interviews, surveys, and analytics to better understand what people need.

I put those ideas into practice by creating productivity tools and social apps with AI coding tools, and by running marketing campaigns.

Featured in MLive / Ann ArborFed up with dating apps? 2 U-M students made a friendship platform instead.
